name: Woodland Whisper · bought feature
description: Woodland Whisper, the feature bought for 100 bets: tgslots packages/games/woodland-whisper/config/config.json (version 2) and src/constants.ts PAYLINE_DATA.

nodes.label: Round win as a multiple of the price paid

payline.name: payline
payline.description: One payline, left to right: the first symbol that is not a Wild sets what the line pays as, Wilds stand in for it, and the longest run from the first reel is looked up in the paytable.

nodes.label: Which symbol the line pays as
How many reels match from the left
Look the payout up: the symbol's row, the count's column
Add it to the spin's line win

paylines.name: paylines
paylines.description: All 5 paylines of the game, each one the same payline subgraph placed on different board cells.

nodes.label: Start the line win at zero

scatter-pay.name: scatter-pay
scatter-pay.description: Scatters pay anywhere: their count selects a multiple of the total bet.

nodes.label: Count the scatters on the board

spin-reels.name: spin-reels
spin-reels.description: Stops each of the 5 reels at a random position and reads the 3 symbols showing on each into the board.

spin.name: spin
spin.description: One spin: the reels stop, the lines and the scatters are paid, and the win is added to the round.

nodes.label: Every mystery cell shows the drawn symbol
3 or more scatters trigger the feature
Add the spin to the round
Remember how much of the spin win the scatters paid

turn-card.name: turn-card
turn-card.description: Turns one card. The first amount to come up twice is the award.

nodes.label: A second card of the same kind wins its amount
Remember that this kind has been turned
Remember the amount on the card

pick-bonus.name: pick-bonus
pick-bonus.description: Pick bonus: cards are turned until two show the same amount, and that amount is the award.

nodes.label: Start with every card face down

award-free-spins.name: award-free-spins
award-free-spins.description: The pick bonus decides how many free spins are awarded.

nodes.label: Pick bonus: turn cards until two match
The matched amount is added to the free spins (at most 2 held)
Remember after which spin the bonus was played

free-spin.name: free-spin
free-spin.description: One step of the feature: the pick bonus if the spin before earned it, then one free spin, played like a paid spin.

nodes.label: The spin before showed 3+ COINs: the pick bonus adds free spins
The spin before showed 3+ COINs: the pick bonus adds free spins

free-spins.name: free-spins
free-spins.description: The feature: every spin with 3+ COINs earns a pick bonus that awards free spins, and every free spin pays ×2.

nodes.label: Play while a pick bonus is due or free spins are left
Pick bonus if due, then a free spin

spin-reels-triggering.name: spin-reels-triggering
spin-reels-triggering.description: Stops the 5 reels so that at least 3 COINs show, with the chances an ordinary spin gives those stops.

nodes.label: How many COINs each reel shows

bought-spin.name: bought-spin
bought-spin.description: The spin a bought feature opens with: an ordinary spin, given that it shows 3 or more COINs.

nodes.label: Every mystery cell shows the drawn symbol
3 or more scatters trigger the feature
Add the spin to the round
Remember how much of the spin win the scatters paid
